This package contains the following policies:

## `network`

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-20

Python hardening rule to allow FTP File transfers via port 20

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-23

Python hardening rule to allow Telnet Command lines via port 23

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-25

Python hardening rule to allow SMTP Sending email via port 25

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-70

Python hardening rule to allow Gopher Document transfers via port 70

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-80

Python hardening rule to allow HTTP webpages via port 80

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-110

Python hardening rule to allow POP3 Fetching email via port 110

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-119

Python hardening rule to allow NNTP Usenet news via port 119

- cnp-python-hardening-policy-allow-only-port-143

Python hardening rule to allow IMAP4 Fetching email via port 143
